answer: Think of signed forklift operator certificate with training provider attestation as a toll booth: a certificate a training provider issued after a practical test, so the willow of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The comet is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The umber is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
